cards.referenceText: HUD stands for Head-up Display, projecting flight data onto a transparent screen in the pilot’s line of sight. Pilots can get information like heading, airspeed, altitude, attitude, glide slope, and runway guidance. It allows pilots to monitor data while observing the outside, enhancing situational awareness.
cards.referenceTextZh: 抬头显示（HUD）是将飞行数据投射到飞行员视野前方透明屏幕的设备。飞行员可从中获取航向、空速、高度、姿态、下滑道及跑道引导等信息，能在观察外界的同时监控数据，提升情景意识。

cards.audioText: Can HUD be used to lower the landing minimum?
cards.audioTextZh: 平视显示器（HUD）可用于降低着陆最低标准吗？
cards.referenceText: A HUD may support operations to lower minima only when the aircraft system, crew training, procedure, airport, and operator approval all meet the applicable requirements. The presence of a HUD alone does not authorize lower minima. Pilots must use the minima stated in the approved procedure and operational authorization.
cards.referenceTextZh: 只有当飞机系统、机组训练、程序、机场和运营人批准都满足适用要求时，HUD 才可能支持较低最低标准运行。仅仅安装 HUD 并不自动授权降低最低标准。飞行员必须使用经批准程序和运行授权中规定的最低标准。

cards.audioText: What other landing aids do you know besides a head-up display?
cards.audioTextZh: 除平视显示器（HUD）外，你还了解其他简易配备的着陆辅助设施吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, other landing equipment includes ILS (provides horizontal or vertical guidance), PAPI (indicates approach path), runway centerline or edge lights (enhances visibility), and EGPWS (prevents terrain collision). These equipment ensure safe landings by supplementing guidance, visibility, and safety warnings.
cards.referenceTextZh: 知道，其他着陆设备包括仪表着陆系统（ILS，提供水平/垂直引导）、精密进近航道指示器（PAPI，指示进近航道）、跑道中心线/边灯（提升能见度）以及增强型近地警告系统（EGPWS，预防撞地）。这些设备通过补充引导、能见度和安全警告保障着陆安全。

cards.referenceText: Pilots use a HUD when it is installed and approved for the operation, particularly during takeoff, approach, and landing. It presents important flight information in the pilot’s forward field of view, which can reduce the need to look down at the instrument panel. The crew still has to monitor all required instruments and follow the approved procedure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当飞机安装 HUD 且该运行获得批准时，飞行员会在起飞、进近和着陆等阶段使用它。HUD 把重要飞行信息显示在飞行员前方视野中，可以减少低头查看仪表板的需要。机组仍必须监控所有规定仪表并遵循经批准程序。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages of using HUD?
cards.audioTextZh: 使用 HUD 有哪些优势？
cards.referenceText: By using HUD, pilots can get the important instrument readings without looking down, so they can scan the outside environment at the same time. This can improve pilot’s situational awareness and ensure flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员无需低头即可获取重要仪表数据，同时可观察外界环境，能提升情景意识，保障飞行安全。

cards.audioText: What kinds of training you need to complete before using the HUD in-flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中使用 HUD 前，需完成哪些培训？
cards.referenceText: According to the regulation, pilots need to take both ground training and flight trainings before using HUD.
cards.referenceTextZh: 根据法规要求，需完成地面培训和飞行培训。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages of using HUD in heavy fog weather?
cards.audioTextZh: 在浓雾天气下,使用HUD的优势是什么？
cards.referenceText: Using HUD in heavy fog offers advantages: integrating flight data (airspeed, altitude) with real-world view, reducing head-down time; providing virtual runway or navigation guidance, enhancing situational awareness; lowering landing minima; and improving approach stability, helping pilots align runways accurately despite low visibility.
cards.referenceTextZh: 浓雾天气下使用平视显示器（HUD）的优势包括：将飞行数据（空速、高度）与实景融合，减少低头看仪表时间；提供虚拟跑道/导航引导，提升情景意识；降低着陆最低标准；增强进近稳定性，帮助飞行员在低能见度下精准对准跑道。

cards.audioText: Do you think HUD operations in adverse weather will be a trend in the future?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为不利天气下HUD运行会变成一种趋势吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, HUD operations in adverse weather will be a future trend. HUD enhances safety by improving situational awareness and reducing human error in low visibility, turbulence, or heavy rain. With aviation technology development, more airlines will equip HUD to improve operational reliability and reduce delays caused by bad weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，不利天气下的平视显示器（HUD）运行将成为未来趋势。HUD在低能见度、颠簸或暴雨等天气中能提升情景意识、减少人为差错，增强安全性。随着航空技术发展，更多航空公司会配备HUD，以提高运行可靠性并减少恶劣天气导致的延误。
